date_system: 公元年；整数；未知为null或CSV空白，不以0代替
source_date_grain: 表中生/登/卒年只有年；剧本有年/月
source_is: secondary transcription of SAN14 game settings, not primary historical attestation

game_and_history_separate.rule: 游戏年的证据不足时不得标记为史实；诸如演义人物保留source_is_fiction标志，待单独审核。

join_policy.identity_key: 官方名单独立条目稳定person_id；不是name
join_policy.four_name_discrepancies: 由名单表单独列出并保留别名；不能强行字符串等号
join_policy.ambiguous_matches: 保留候选与疑点，禁止随机按同名首条覆盖

scenario_year_filter.birth_boundary: birth_year <= scenario_year，包括生年当年；只说明年度候选，不代表该年可出仕
scenario_year_filter.death_boundary: scenario_year <= death_year，卒年当年保留为boundary_uncertain；若scenario_year > death_year排除
scenario_year_filter.missing_year: 资格为unknown，不自动纳入或排除；需要剧本明确覆盖规则
scenario_year_filter.same_death_year: 只能确定同年，月份未知；可用来源剧本状态覆盖年度估算并保留来源
scenario_year_filter.not_counted_as_active: 未出生、未登场、未知资格分别统计；不是库中缺失人物
scenario_year_filter.age_estimate: 只展示year-birth_year的年差，非已确认实岁；不用于自动生成登场年

lifespan_modes.historical_setting: 采用有来源的游戏寿命/历史卒年配置，不能把待验证表当真实史事
lifespan_modes.fictional: 可关闭寿命和出生限制；例如来源251英雄列，不加入历史年份可用人数统计
lifespan_modes.legacy_nes: 保留原移除状态/事件与原出现表，不让新历史年表自动改旧流程

import_schema_minimum.scenario_membership: one row per person/scenario; raw+parsed status, nullable city/faction IDs
import_schema_minimum.san14_stats: five nullable ints with source/version; not populated from name list
import_schema_minimum.nes_profile: nullable conversion result plus original/raw evidence; no default guessed as verified

validation_rules: appearance>=birth when both known; violations reviewed, never silently repaired
source two table year triplets agree before merge
no random assignment of homonym chronology
official candidate count remains distinct-entity count, not name-string count
source game dates and proposed gameplay defaults have separate columns
unknowns do not become0 or invented15-year appearance
late heroes remain in whole database and appear only per scenario rules
